rule: One user, one decision, one proof reason, one money rule, and one action.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, escrow, payout, deposit, booking fee, or supplier settlement is collected by Heavyster in phase one.

roles.proof_reason: Trust and availability are visible before enquiry
roles.money_rule: Buyer pays supplier direct; Heavyster takes 0% rental

roles.proof_reason: Profile, proof, and availability are visible before publishing
roles.money_rule: USD 9/month or USD 99/year per active listing

roles.decision: Fill the strongest market supply gap
roles.proof_reason: Demand, trust, and listing ARR identify one wedge
roles.money_rule: Scale listing SaaS before any rental commission

global_simplicity: Keep the concierge visible before the hero on marketplace entry.
Show the active role without opening the workflow drawer.
Use the same four tiles for every role: decision, proof, money, next.
Never ask the user to compare more than one primary action.
Keep rental payment direct between buyer and supplier.
acceptance: Marketplace includes Calm Decision Concierge after Calm Global Compass.
Buyer mode can copy one enquiry from the concierge.
Supplier mode opens the supplier workbench from the concierge.
Founder mode opens the market command from the concierge.
Build Phase shows the v147 contract and copy button.
Copy text states 0% rental take and listing SaaS revenue first.
